summary: Raw paste reads send a strong ETag made from the paste metadata. A matching If-None-Match gets 304 Not Modified before the content read, so a revalidation costs one metadata read and no body. Public caching (Cache-Control: public, max-age=CACHE_PASTE_AGE) and Last-Modified stay.

intent.objective: Make repeated paste reads faster with a strong ETag and 304 answers to a matching If-None-Match, without a content read.

assumptions.rationale: A 304 answer skips the content read. That is correct only when a content read has no side effects.
Every paste may be cached and revalidated with its ETag, so a 304 answer is always correct.

preservedInvariants: Raw reads send Cache-Control: public, max-age=CACHE_PASTE_AGE.
Last-Modified and If-Modified-Since behave as before.
A new upload or update changes the ETag.
